integrity: The counterexample and repaired bound are proved symbolically from the definitions; no numerical experiment, unpublished third-party claim, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: This finding corrects the endpoint of one perturbation theorem. It does not classify all controlled g-frame perturbations, and an unindexed erratum or informal observation may contain the same correction.
title: Sharp endpoint for a controlled g-frame perturbation theorem
